player_prompt.intro:
Uwiteka umukino {player_id} mu mukino wa HighSociety (igihembwe cy'abakinnyi 2).
Ituruka ry'umukino:  Kadi 10 za prestige zitangazwa kimwe nyuma ya nyingine.
Gukwirakwiza:    Mu kuzinduka, hitamo kadi ya amafaranga 1-11 na ikoreshe.
            • Ikwirakwiza kirekire cyashusha kadi ya prestige na kuyikwirakwiza.
            • Ikwirakwiza kirekire kiyakira kadi ye ya amafaranga.
            • Gukwirakwiza kuwushyu -> ibikwirakwiza byombi birahabwa na kadi imwe ya prestige itangazwa.
Kugura:    Nyuma y'auctions zose, ongeza **amafaranga asigaye + amapoint ya prestige**.
            *Amarangi y'umwitero* ashushye (guturana kinyamwuga -> gushyu).

**Sintagiri ya Kugura**  →  kwirakwiza kadi moja kama '[7]' au '[11]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Namuhitamo kuzigira cyane kimwe cya [X] kadi ya amafaranga.

message.auction_result: P0 yashatse {bid0}, P1 yashatse {bid1}. Umukino {winner} ushusha prestige {prize} (jumla {total}).
